newsitem.title: UK: Britain's SFO widens NatWest Markets probe -paper.
newsitem.headline: Britain's SFO widens NatWest Markets probe -paper.

text.p: The Serious Fraud Office (SFO) probe into the 90 million stg loss ($153 million) on derivatives trading by NatWest Markets has widened to include the former boss of rogue trader Kyriacos Papouis, the Observer newspaper said.

Neil Dodgson, the former global head of interest rate options at NatWest Markets, the investment banking arm of National Westminster Bank Plc, left NatWest last month. The bank made no allegations against him other than failure to supervise Papouis.

The SFO, which investigates cases of complex and serious financial fraud, is expected to decide shortly whether to launch a criminal investigation or leave the Bank of England and the Securities and Futures Authority to discipline those involved.
The SFO was unavailable for comment.
